QUOTE: "schema: nothing the caller can do through this process clears it. Auto-refresh skips it, because a rebuild re-stamps the same newer version." and "The remedy is to restart the MCP client so it loads current code, then run `index(action='refresh', force=True)`." and "data: the server refreshes automatically... A caller can also run `index(action='refresh')`."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer lists different remedies per axis (refresh for data, client restart for code) but never says this is why a single flag would not have been enough.
